parameters.content:
## alice-dms-lifecycle

MQTT-triggered, event-driven workflow (PROJ-22, PROJ-44).
Subscribes to `alice/dms/lifecycle` (published by alice-dms-scanner).

### Actions
- `add_path` — Duplicate file found at new path.
  PATCH Weaviate: append to additionalPaths[].
  Redis: HSET path_to_hash + SADD hash_to_paths.
- `update_path` — File moved; old path(s) gone.
  PATCH Weaviate: set filePath = new path.
  Redis: HDEL/SREM old paths + HSET/SADD new path.
- `delete_file` — File deleted from DMS; no copies remain. (PROJ-44)
  If BankStatement: cascade-delete all BankTransaction children first.
  Then DELETE thumbnail (thumbnailer) + parent Weaviate object (PROJ-113).
  THEN Redis: HDEL/SREM the dead path, SREM processed (PROJ-113: Redis is
  cleaned up here, after Weaviate — no longer by the scanner).
- `remove_path` — One path gone, copies live on at `alive_paths` (PROJ-113).
  PATCH Weaviate: dead path out of additionalPaths; if it was the main path,
  the first live path becomes the main path. THEN Redis: HDEL/SREM dead path.

All actions also find `Image` objects (field `file_hash` / `file_path`, PROJ-113).
A failed Weaviate lookup throws — Redis stays unchanged, the scanner re-reports.

### Error Handling
- Missing fields / malformed JSON → throw (logged as failed execution)
- Unknown action → discard (empty return, not an error)
- Weaviate object not found → log warning, no-op (already cleaned up)
- Weaviate PATCH failure → throw (logged, Redis skipped for consistency)
- Weaviate DELETE failure → throw
- Redis failure → throw (MQTT error published by n8n error handler)

### Dependencies
- PROJ-19: path_to_hash + hash_to_paths Redis mappings
- PROJ-21: Scanner publishes to alice/dms/lifecycle
- PROJ-29: BankTransaction collection with parentStatementId
- PROJ-44: delete_file cascade-delete

### Credentials
- mqtt-alice (Kqy6cn7hyDDXrBA0)
- redis-alice (DtO8rm7fWa7IYMen) — via $env.REDIS_PASSWORD
